newsitem.title: CHINA: FORECAST - China 96-97 sugar output seen up 5.97 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - China 96-97 sugar output seen up 5.97 pct.

text.p: China's sugar output is forecast to rise 378,000 tonnes, or 5.97 percent, to 6.6 million tonnes in the 1996-97 sugar year compared with the previous year, the Xinhua news agency said.

In the southern province of Guangxi, sugar output was expected to climb 200,000 tonnes to 2.6 million tonnes in the 1996-97 season (October-September), Xinhua said late on Monday. It gave no further details.
State media had forecast sugar output at 6.53 million tonnes in 1996-97 due to a government increase in the price at which it buys sugar from farmers.
